```{r Step 1: Call IPUMS Microdata, include=TRUE}
# ============================================================
# IPUMS CPS ASEC INGESTION
# Wage Premium / Good Jobs Measure
#
# Project: Precariat Politics
# Years: 2000-2024
# ============================================================

library(tidyverse)
library(ipumsr)
library(here)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Directories
# ------------------------------------------------------------

dir.create(
  here("00_rawdata", "IPUMS_CPS"),
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)

dir.create(
  here("01_tidydata", "IPUMS_CPS"),
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# IPUMS API key
# ------------------------------------------------------------

set_ipums_api_key(
  Sys.getenv("ipums_api_key")
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Define ASEC samples
# ------------------------------------------------------------

years <- 2000:2024

asec_samples <- paste0(
  "cps",
  years,
  "_03s"
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Define variables
# ------------------------------------------------------------

cps_vars <- c(

  # Time
  "YEAR",

  # Demographics
  "AGE",
  "SEX",
  "RACE",
  "HISPAN",
  "MARST",

  # Education
  "EDUC",

  # Employment
  "EMPSTAT",
  "CLASSWKR",

  # Industry and occupation
  "IND",
  "OCC",

  # Geography
  "STATEFIP",
  "REGION",

  # Earnings
  "INCWAGE",

  # Work intensity
  "WKSWORK1",
  "UHRSWORKLY",

  # Survey weight
  "ASECWT"
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Create IPUMS extract
# ------------------------------------------------------------

extract_definition <- define_extract_micro(
  collection = "cps",

  description = paste(
    "Precariat Politics:",
    "CPS ASEC data for industry wage premium analysis,",
    "2000-2024"
  ),

  samples = asec_samples,

  variables = cps_vars
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Submit extract
# ------------------------------------------------------------

submitted_extract <- submit_extract(
  extract_definition
)

submitted_extract$number

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Wait for extract
# ------------------------------------------------------------

downloadable_extract <- wait_for_extract(
  submitted_extract
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Download extract
# ------------------------------------------------------------

ddi_path <- download_extract(
  downloadable_extract,
  download_dir = here(
    "00_rawdata",
    "IPUMS_CPS"
  )
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Read data
# ------------------------------------------------------------

cps_asec_raw <- read_ipums_micro(
  ddi_path
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Save raw R object
# ------------------------------------------------------------



# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Create analysis dataset
# ------------------------------------------------------------

cps_wage <- cps_asec_raw %>%
  transmute(
    year = YEAR,
    age = AGE,
    sex = SEX,
    race = RACE,
    hispan = HISPAN,
    marital_status = MARST,
    educ = EDUC,
    empstat = EMPSTAT,
    classwkr = CLASSWKR,
    industry = IND,
    occupation = OCC,
    statefip = STATEFIP,
    region = REGION,
    wage_income = INCWAGE,
    weeks_worked = WKSWORK1,
    usual_hours_last_year = UHRSWORKLY,
    asecwt = ASECWT
  )

# ------------------------------------------------------------ 
# Inspect structure 
# ------------------------------------------------------------ 
glimpse(cps_wage) 
# ------------------------------------------------------------ 
# Inspect variable labels and coding 
# ------------------------------------------------------------ 
ipums_var_info(cps_wage) 
# ------------------------------------------------------------ 
# Education 
# ------------------------------------------------------------ 
ddi <- attr(cps_wage, "ipums_ddi") 
# Basic distribution 
summary(cps_wage$educ) 
# Frequency table 
table(cps_wage$educ, useNA = "ifany") 
# ------------------------------------------------------------ 
# Employment status 
# ------------------------------------------------------------ 
summary(cps_wage$empstat) 
table( cps_wage$empstat, useNA = "ifany" ) 
# ------------------------------------------------------------ 
# Class of worker 
# ------------------------------------------------------------ 
summary(cps_wage$classwkr) 
table( cps_wage$classwkr, useNA = "ifany" ) 
# ------------------------------------------------------------ 
# Industry 
# ------------------------------------------------------------ 
summary(cps_wage$industry) 
# Number of unique industry categories 
n_distinct(cps_wage$industry) 
# ------------------------------------------------------------ 
# Occupation 
# ------------------------------------------------------------ 
summary(cps_wage$occupation) 
# Number of unique occupation categories n_distinct(cps_wage$OCC) 
# ------------------------------------------------------------ 
# Work intensity 
# ------------------------------------------------------------ 
summary(cps_wage$weeks_worked) 
summary(cps_wage$usual_hours_last_year) 
# ------------------------------------------------------------ 
# Earnings 
# ------------------------------------------------------------ 
summary(cps_wage$wage_income) 
# ------------------------------------------------------------ 
# Weight 
# ------------------------------------------------------------ 
summary(cps_wage$asecwt) 
# ------------------------------------------------------------ 
# Year coverage 
# ------------------------------------------------------------ 
table(cps_wage$year)


```


```{r Step 2, Cleaning CPS Pull, include=TRUE}
# ============================================================
# STEP 2. CLEANING CPS PULL
# ============================================================

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Initial restriction
# ------------------------------------------------------------

# Apply the largest, simplest restrictions BEFORE creating
# additional full-length vectors. This substantially reduces
# memory requirements.

cps_wage_clean <- cps_wage %>%
  filter(
    age >= 25,
    age <= 64,
    wage_income > 0,
    usual_hours_last_year >= 35,
    asecwt > 0
  ) %>%
  select(
    year,
    age,
    sex,
    race,
    hispan,
    marital_status,
    educ,
    empstat,
    classwkr,
    industry,
    occupation,
    statefip,
    region,
    wage_income,
    weeks_worked,
    usual_hours_last_year,
    asecwt
  )


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Clean variables
# ------------------------------------------------------------

cps_wage_clean <- cps_wage_clean %>%
  mutate(
    
    # Earnings
    wage_income_clean = if_else(
      wage_income >= 0 &
        wage_income < 99999999,
      wage_income,
      NA_real_
    ),
    
    # Usual weekly hours
    usual_hours_clean = if_else(
      usual_hours_last_year >= 1 &
        usual_hours_last_year <= 99,
      usual_hours_last_year,
      NA_real_
    ),
    
    # Weeks worked
    weeks_worked_clean = if_else(
      weeks_worked >= 0 &
        weeks_worked <= 52,
      weeks_worked,
      NA_real_
    ),
    
    # Industry
    industry_clean = if_else(
      industry > 0,
      industry,
      NA_real_
    ),
    
    # Occupation
    occupation_clean = if_else(
      occupation > 0,
      occupation,
      NA_real_
    ),
    
    # ASEC weight
    asecwt_clean = if_else(
      asecwt > 0,
      asecwt,
      NA_real_
    ),
    
    # Worker type
    worker_type = case_when(
      classwkr %in% c(13, 14) ~ "Self-employed",
      classwkr %in% c(21, 22, 23, 25, 27, 28) ~
        "Wage and salary",
      classwkr == 26 ~ "Armed forces",
      classwkr == 29 ~ "Unpaid family worker",
      classwkr %in% c(0, 99) ~ NA_character_,
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )


# ------------------------------------------------------------ 
# Education category and years of schooling 
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Use lookup vectors rather than case_when().  
educ_labels <- c( 
  `1` = "No schooling", `2` = "Less than 1st grade", `10` = "1st, 2nd, 3rd, or 4th grade", `20` = "5th or 6th grade", `30` = "7th or 8th grade", `40` = "9th grade", `50` = "10th grade", `60` = "11th grade", `71` = "12th grade, no diploma", `73` = "High school graduate", `81` = "Some college, no degree", `91` = "Associate degree, occupational", `92` = "Associate degree, academic", `111` = "Bachelor's degree", `123` = "Master's degree", `124` = "Professional degree", `125` = "Doctorate" 
  )

educ_years <- c( 
  `1` = 0, `2` = 0, `10` = 2, `20` = 5, `30` = 7, `40` = 9, `50` = 10, `60` = 11, `71` = 12, `73` = 12, `81` = 14, `91` = 14, `92` = 14, `111` = 16, `123` = 18, `124` = 19, `125` = 20 
  )

# Convert labelled EDUC to its underlying numeric codes 
educ_code <- as.character(as.numeric(cps_wage_clean$educ)) 
cps_wage_clean$educ_category <- unname( educ_labels[educ_code] ) 
cps_wage_clean$years_schooling <- as.numeric( unname(educ_years[educ_code])
                                              ) 
rm(educ_code, educ_labels, educ_years) 
gc() 

# ------------------------------------------------------------ 
# Potential labor-market experience 
# ------------------------------------------------------------ 
cps_wage_clean$potential_experience <- cps_wage_clean$age - cps_wage_clean$years_schooling - 6 
cps_wage_clean$potential_experience[ cps_wage_clean$potential_experience < 0 ] <- NA_real_ 
cps_wage_clean$potential_experience_sq <- cps_wage_clean$potential_experience^2 
gc()

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 11. Create descriptive sample statistics
# ------------------------------------------------------------

sample_statistics <- cps_wage_analysis %>%

  summarise(

    observations = n(),

    years = n_distinct(year),

    mean_age = mean(
      age,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    mean_wage =
      weighted.mean(
        wage_income_clean,
        asecwt_clean,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),

    median_wage =
      median(
        wage_income_clean,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),

    mean_hours =
      weighted.mean(
        usual_hours_clean,
        asecwt_clean,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),

    mean_weeks =
      weighted.mean(
        weeks_worked_clean,
        asecwt_clean,
        na.rm = TRUE
      )

  )


print(sample_statistics)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 12. Annual sample sizes
# ------------------------------------------------------------

annual_sample <- cps_wage_analysis %>%

  group_by(year) %>%

  summarise(

    n = n(),

    weighted_n =
      sum(
        asecwt_clean,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),

    mean_wage =
      weighted.mean(
        wage_income_clean,
        asecwt_clean,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),

    mean_hours =
      weighted.mean(
        usual_hours_clean,
        asecwt_clean,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),

    mean_weeks =
      weighted.mean(
        weeks_worked_clean,
        asecwt_clean,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),

    .groups = "drop"

  )


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 13. Industry-year sample sizes
# ------------------------------------------------------------

industry_sample <- cps_wage_analysis %>%

  group_by(
    year,
    industry_clean
  ) %>%

  summarise(

    n = n(),

    weighted_n =
      sum(
        asecwt_clean,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),

    .groups = "drop"

  )

industry_counts <- cps_wage_analysis %>%
  count(
    year,
    industry,
    name = "n"
  )


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 14. Industry-year descriptive earnings
# ------------------------------------------------------------

industry_wages <- cps_wage_analysis %>%

  group_by(
    year,
    industry_clean
  ) %>%

  summarise(

    n = n(),

    weighted_mean_wage =
      weighted.mean(
        wage_income_clean,
        asecwt_clean,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),

    weighted_mean_log_wage =
      weighted.mean(
        log_wage_income,
        asecwt_clean,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),

    .groups = "drop"

  )



# ============================================================
# BASELINE ANALYTIC SAMPLE
# ============================================================

cps_wage_analysis <- cps_wage_clean %>%
  filter(
    wage_income_clean > 0,
    weeks_worked_clean > 0,
    !is.na(industry_clean),
    !is.na(occupation_clean),
    !is.na(asecwt_clean),
    !is.na(years_schooling),
    !is.na(potential_experience),

    # Primary wage-and-salary sample
    worker_type == "Wage and salary"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    log_wage_income = log(wage_income_clean),
    
    worked_26plus_weeks =
      weeks_worked_clean >= 26,
    
    worked_40plus_weeks =
      weeks_worked_clean >= 40,
    
    worked_50plus_weeks =
      weeks_worked_clean >= 50,
    
    full_year_worker =
      weeks_worked_clean >= 50
  )


# ============================================================
# FULL-YEAR ROBUSTNESS SAMPLE
# ============================================================

cps_wage_full_year <- cps_wage_analysis %>%
  filter(
    weeks_worked_clean >= 50
  )
```



```{r Step 3, Validating Analytical Sample, include=TRUE}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Create Attrition Table
# ------------------------------------------------------------

attrition_0 <- cps_wage_clean 

attrition_1 <- attrition_0 %>% 
  filter( age >= 25, age <= 64 ) 

attrition_2 <- attrition_1 %>% 
  filter( !is.na(wage_income_clean), wage_income_clean > 0 ) 

attrition_3 <- attrition_2 %>% 
  filter( !is.na(weeks_worked_clean), weeks_worked_clean > 0 ) 

attrition_4 <- attrition_3 %>% 
  filter( !is.na(usual_hours_clean), usual_hours_clean >= 35 ) 

attrition_5 <- attrition_4 %>% 
  filter( !is.na(industry_clean) ) 

attrition_6 <- attrition_5 %>% 
  filter( !is.na(occupation_clean) ) 

attrition_7 <- attrition_6 %>% 
  filter( !is.na(asecwt_clean) ) 

attrition_8 <- attrition_7 %>% 
  filter( !is.na(years_schooling) ) 

attrition_9 <- attrition_8 %>% 
  filter( !is.na(potential_experience) ) 

attrition_10 <- attrition_9 %>%
  filter (!is.na(classwkr), classwkr %in% c(21, 22, 23, 25, 27, 28))

# ------------------------------------------------------------ 
# 11b. Assemble attrition table 
# ------------------------------------------------------------ 
attrition_table <- tibble( 
  step = 0:10, criterion = c( 
    "Full IPUMS-CPS ASEC extract", 
    "Age 25-64", 
    "Positive valid wage income", 
    "Worked at least one week", 
    "Usually worked 35+ hours/week", 
    "Valid industry", 
    "Valid occupation", 
    "Valid ASEC weight", 
    "Valid education", 
    "Valid potential experience",
    "Only Wage Employees"), 
  observations = c( 
    nrow(attrition_0), 
    nrow(attrition_1), 
    nrow(attrition_2), 
    nrow(attrition_3), 
    nrow(attrition_4), 
    nrow(attrition_5), 
    nrow(attrition_6), 
    nrow(attrition_7), 
    nrow(attrition_8), 
    nrow(attrition_9),
    nrow(attrition_10)
              )
  ) %>% 
  mutate( 
    observations_lost = observations - lag(observations), 
    observations_lost = replace_na( observations_lost, 0 ), 
    percent_of_original = 100 * observations / first(observations), 
    percent_retained_from_previous = 100 * observations / lag(observations), 
    percent_retained_from_previous = replace_na( percent_retained_from_previous, 100 ) 
  ) 
# ------------------------------------------------------------ 
# 11c. Print attrition table 
# ------------------------------------------------------------ 
print(attrition_table)


```
